Name: Multiplayer Nametags
Author: Aapodot
Description:
[size=5][b]Multiplayer Nametags
[/b][/size]
Adds customizable floating nametags above characters in Stardew Valley.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Show nametags above your own character
[*]Show nametags above other players in multiplayer
[*]Show nametags above NPCs/villagers
[*]Show nametags above pets
[*]Show nametags above farm animals
[*]Smooth floating animation (optional)
[*]Customizable text color (White, Yellow, Green, Red)
[*]Adjustable vertical position
[*]Adjustable background opacity
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (required)
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Install Generic Mod Config Menu
[*]Download this mod and unzip into your Mods folder
[*]Run the game!
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Open the game menu, go to Mod Options, and find "Multiplayer Nametags" to customize all settings.


[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]

[*]Install Generic Mod Config Menu
[*]Download this mod and unzip into your Mods folder

[/list]
